subject: Tri-cloud acceptance milestones, billing consolidation & PO close checklist
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Alice Johnson <alice.j@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-17T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Draft MAP + acceptance milestones for tri-cloud private offers

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for the call earlier. As promised, I attached a lightweight Mutual Action Plan (TriCloud_MAP_v1.xlsx) that consolidates the acceptance milestones across AWS Private Offer, GCP Private Offer, and an Azure quoting lane. This is intentionally tight — we want to align procurement milestones (legal/PO), technical acceptance (security & test workload), and finance invoicing so you don’t get duplicated invoices across clouds.

Key asks in this draft:
- Confirm the finance billing contact and PO flow (see invoice recipient field in the sheet).
- Point-of-contact for technical acceptance (name + email) so we can schedule final run at the test window.
- If you have any internal constraints on certificate/invoicing cadence (e.g., net-30 vs net-45), flag now so we can adjust the billing milestone.

I also attached a short SOC2 summary and our proposed Private Offer terms for Helix Health. Marcus will drive the AWS/GCP PO creation once we have the procurement contacts and the signed terms.

Proposed high-level timeline (subject to your confirmation):
- Week 0 (Nov 17): Share MAP and terms — collect procurement contacts
- Week 1 (Nov 24): Redwood raises Private Offers (AWS & GCP) and Azure quote sent to your portal
- Week 2 (Dec 1): Legal review & signoff, PO issuance by Helix finance
- Week 3 (Dec 8): Technical acceptance run + smoke tests
- Week 4 (Dec 15): Production cutover and consolidated billing start date

I’ve linked the Google sheet and put the HubSpot deal in the header for reference. If that timeline is tight for your finance team, we can stretch it by a week but wanted to propose an aggressive, predictable close that minimizes duplicate procurement work.

Next steps: please reply with the procurement contact + finance invoicing email and we’ll start the PO workflows.

Thanks —
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: TriCloud_MAP_v1.xlsx, SOC2_Summary.pdf, PrivateOffer_Terms_helix.docx
From: Alice Johnson <alice.j@helixhealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@helixhealth.com>
Date: 2025-11-17T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + acceptance milestones for tri-cloud private offers

Priya —

Appreciate the clear plan and the single-sheet MAP. A few quick items from procurement and finance:

1) Billing destination: invoices should go to finance@helixhealth.com and reference our PO number once issued.
2) We prefer net-45 on initial term and require vendor W-9 / tax profile on the vendor record.
3) For compliance: can you confirm the SOC2 report is the full assessment or an executive summary? Procurement needs at least the summary first; security will request the full report under NDA.

Technical acceptance: I’ll loop in Bob Chen from procurement who will own the PO issuance. For the acceptance run, our infra lead is Samir Patel (samir.p@helixhealth.com). He prefers acceptance windows on Tue/Wed afternoons PST.

If you can incorporate the finance contact and the net-45 term into the MAP, we can review and get back with any legal comments by next Thursday (Nov 24).

—Alice
Alice Johnson
Head of Commercial Operations, Helix Health
alice.j@helixhealth.com | +1 617-555-9988
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Bob Chen <bob.chen@helixhealth.com>, Alice Johnson <alice.j@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-18T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + acceptance milestones for tri-cloud private offers

Bob / Alice —

Thanks — this is helpful. Quick confirmations and updates to the MAP based on your notes below. (Quoted for context.)

On Mon, Nov 17, 2025 at 11:04 AM Alice Johnson <alice.j@helixhealth.com> wrote:
> 1) Billing destination: invoices should go to finance@helixhealth.com and reference our PO number once issued.
> 2) We prefer net-45 on initial term and require vendor W-9 / tax profile on the vendor record.
> 3) For compliance: can you confirm the SOC2 report is the full assessment or an executive summary?

We updated the TriCloud_MAP_v1.xlsx (attached as TriCloud_MAP_v1.xlsx) to show:
- Invoice recipient: finance@helixhealth.com (we’ll include this in the Private Offer invoice metadata).
- Payment term: net-45 (we’ll record this as the finance milestone; Redwood finance will accept net-45 for Helix on the first invoice).
- Vendor tax: Marcus attached a vendor-info checklist; we can provide a W-9 and vendor tax profile immediately.
- SOC2: the attached SOC2_Summary.pdf is an executive summary intended for procurement. We will share the full report under NDA; I included a link to our security portal in the related links for Bob/Samir to request the full artefact.

Operational plan summary (who does what):
- Redwood (Marcus): raise AWS & GCP Private Offers by Nov 24; create Azure quoted invoice lane and place the acceptance criteria inside the MAP.
- Helix (Bob): confirm PO number and issue PO via finance@helixhealth.com by Dec 1 (or let us know if you need the timeline extended).
- Helix (Samir): lead the technical acceptance run during the week of Dec 8; Redwood to provide test checklist and a 2-hour acceptance window.

Links: HubSpot deal DL-58921 (https://app.hubspot.com/deals/58921) and the MAP (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1TriCloudMAPExample). I’ve also added a DocuSign envelope for the PrivateOffer_Terms_helix.docx so legal can e-sign once you’re ready.

If that works, Marcus will start the PO workflows and I’ll follow up with the vendor W-9 and our accounting contact for invoicing metadata.

Thanks —
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: TriCloud_MAP_v1.xlsx, PrivateOffer_Terms_helix.docx, SOC2_Summary.pdf
From: Bob Chen <bob.chen@helixhealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Alice Johnson <alice.j@helixhealth.com>
Date: 2025-11-20T14:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + acceptance milestones for tri-cloud private offers

Priya / Alice —

We reviewed the MAP with finance and can confirm the following:
- PO issuance: we will aim to issue PO #HH-2025-774 by Dec 1 and send to finance@helixhealth.com.
- Invoice routing: please send the first invoice to finance@helixhealth.com and reference PO HH-2025-774 once issued.
- Net-45 is accepted for the initial term.

One small change: Samir asked that the acceptance window be Wed Dec 10, 2pm–4pm PST (instead of the week of Dec 8). That works for our internal calendar.

Please proceed with the Private Offer creation for AWS & GCP on Nov 24 and the Azure quote lane; Marcus, please confirm when the offers are created so we can start the legal review.

Bob Chen
Procurement Manager, Helix Health
bob.chen@helixhealth.com | +1 617-555-0102
